Recitals
This Agreement is made on 2026-08-27 between Lantern Rights Pte. Ltd. (“Licensor”) and StreamArc
Media Inc. (“Licensee”).
Licensor controls the expressly identified rights in the Licensed Subject Matter, and Licensee wishes to
exploit those rights only within the media, territory, period and exclusivity stated in this Agreement.
The parties acknowledge that an audiovisual work, a soundtrack master and other related assets may
constitute legally distinct subject matter. No right is granted by implication.

Article 1 (Definitions)
“Licensed Subject Matter” means only the audiovisual work or related asset identified by title and
scope in this Agreement or an incorporated Schedule.
“Service” means the particular subscription video-on-demand, transactional video-on-demand, linear
television, music-streaming or other exploitation mode stated for a grant. This definition does not
enlarge an operative grant.
“License Period” means the period stated for an individual grant and is not presumed to be the same
as the term of this Agreement.
“Materials” means the picture, audio, subtitle, still, cue-sheet and metadata elements expressly listed
for delivery.

Article 3 (Grant of Rights)
For exploitation by subscription video-on-demand (SVOD), the Licensed Subject Matter for this grant is
limited to “The Name Remembered by Rain”. It is not automatically merged with any unlisted
audiovisual work or related asset.
Licensor grants Licensee the non-exclusive interactive transmission and making-available right in “The
Name Remembered by Rain” solely for exploitation by subscription video-on-demand (SVOD). Every
right and mode not expressly granted is reserved to Licensor.
For “The Name Remembered by Rain” exploited by subscription video-on-demand (SVOD), the
Territory is the United States and the License Period is from 2027-01-01 through 2029-12-31, inclusive.
Exclusivity applies only to the combined right, mode, territory and period stated here.
This grant is a sublicense to a content platform operator. Licensor represents that it holds sublicensing
authority for that recipient and the precise grant scope stated above.

Article 4 (Restrictions and Reserved Rights)
Except for technical copies reasonably required to operate an authorised Service, Licensee shall not
edit, re-purpose or supply the Licensed Subject Matter to a third party. Unstated remake, sequel,
format, merchandising, theatrical, broadcast and stand-alone music rights are reserved.
Licensee shall maintain geo-blocking, access controls and rights-management information. On
learning of exploitation outside the grant, Licensee shall promptly stop that use and notify Licensor.

Article 5 (Delivery and Acceptance)
By the agreed delivery date, Licensor shall provide serviceable picture or audio masters, available
subtitle or script materials, approved stills and core metadata by secure transfer.
Licensee shall inspect technical conformity within ten business days and give particularised notice of
material defects. Failure to give timely technical notice does not waive a latent chain-of-title claim.

Article 7 (Consideration and Payment)
Total consideration is 904,000.00 USD, payable in USD. Licensee shall pay it as follows: 50%
(452,000.00 USD, within 15 business days after signing); 50% (452,000.00 USD, within 15 business
days after acceptance). The stated amounts exclude applicable indirect taxes.

Article 8 (Statements, Records and Audit)
Licensee shall retain records sufficient to identify the territory, mode, availability period and relevant
transactions for three years after expiry.
Where usage or revenue accounting applies, Licensor may once per year appoint an independent
professional to examine relevant records on reasonable notice, during business hours and subject to
confidentiality.

Article 9 (Representations and Warranties)
Each party represents that it is duly organised and has power to enter into and perform this
Agreement, and that its signatory is duly authorised to bind it.
Licensor represents that it controls the express grant. That representation excludes music, trade mark,
likeness and third-party materials expressly allocated to Licensee for separate clearance.

Article 10 (Indemnity and Limitation of Liability)
A party shall indemnify the other against direct third-party claims and reasonable costs arising from its
breach, wilful misconduct or gross negligence, provided prompt notice and reasonable cooperation are
given.
Except for liability that cannot lawfully be limited, neither party is liable for indirect, special or
consequential loss or lost profits. This exclusion does not apply to payment obligations, confidentiality
breaches or infringement liability.

Article 12 (Agreement Term and License Periods)
This Agreement takes effect on the Agreement Date and continues until all License Periods and
outstanding accounting obligations have ended. The agreement term neither replaces nor
automatically extends an individual License Period.
Each License Period includes its stated first and last dates. Renewal or additional exploitation is
effective only by a separate written agreement.

Article 14 (Sublicensing, Assignment and Affiliates)
Sublicensing is permitted only where and to the extent stated in the applicable grant. Neither party may
assign this Agreement or a material obligation without prior written consent; use of a technical vendor
is not itself an assignment.
Licensee remains responsible for the acts of permitted vendors and affiliates and shall ensure their
compliance with the territory, period, mode and security conditions.

Article 19 (Execution)
The parties, acting through their duly authorised representatives, execute this Agreement after
reviewing all of its terms.
